verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              ततो रजन्यां व्युष्टायां प्रभातेऽभ्युदिते रवौ। कद्रूश्च विनता चैव भगिन्यौ ते तपोधन॥१॥
verses.english: Sauti said: O Rishi, when the night was gone and the sun rose in the morning, the sisters, Kadru and Vinata.

verses.sanskrit: अमर्षिते सुसंरब्धे दास्ये कृतपणे तदा। जग्मतुस्तुरगं द्रष्टुमुच्चैःश्रवसमन्तिकात्॥२॥
verses.english: Having laid an wager of slavery and burning with jealously, went to see the horse Uchchaishrava.
verses.bhavadeepa: एकविंशतितमः अध्यायः तत इति । व्युष्टायां व्यतीतायाम् ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: ददृशातेऽथ ते तत्र समुद्रं निधिमम्भसाम्। महान्तमुदकागाधं क्षोभ्यमाणं महास्वनम्॥३॥
verses.english: On their way they saw the great ocean, vast and deep, agitated by wind, making a tremendous roar.

verses.sanskrit: तिमिंगिलझषाकीर्णं मकरैरावृतं तथा। सत्वैश्च बहुसाहस्रैर्नानारूपैः समावृतम्॥४॥
verses.english: It was full of whales, fishes large enough to swallow whales, Makaras, tortoises and creatures of various forms by thousands.
It was inaccessible by any creatures on account of the presence of terrible, monstershaped, dark and fierce aquatic animals. It was full of crocodiles and tortoises.

verses.sanskrit: आकरं सर्वरत्नानामालयं वरुणस्य च। नागानामालयं रम्यमुत्तमं सरितां पतिम्॥६॥
verses.english: It abounded with all kinds of gems; it was the home of Varuna, the beautiful and excellent abode of the Nagas; it was the lord of all rivers.

verses.sanskrit: पातालज्वलनावासमसुराणां च बान्धवम्। भयंकरं च सत्त्वानां पयसां निधिमर्णवम्॥७॥
verses.english: It was the abode of subterranean fire, the friend of the Asuras, the terror of all creatures, the great reservoir of waters, having no deterioration.

verses.sanskrit: शुभं दिव्यममर्त्यानाममृतस्याकरं परम्। अप्रमेयमचिन्त्यं च सुपुण्यजलमद्भुतम्॥८॥
verses.english: It was holy, it was beneficial to the celestials, it was the great mine of Ambrosia, it was infinite, inconceivable, sacred and highly wonderful.
verses.bhavadeepa: पातालज्वलनो वाडवाग्निस्तस्यावासम् । बान्धवं शरणम् । बन्धनमिति पाठे कारागारम् ॥७॥

verses.english: It was fearful with the terrible roars of acquatic creatures, tremendously-roaring and full of deep whirlpools. It was an object of terror to all creatures.
Moved by winds, heaving high with agitation and disturbance, it seemed to dance everywhere with uplifted hands represented by its waves.
It was full of heaving billows, caused by the changes of the moon, it was the parent of (the great conch of Krishna) Panchajanya, it was the great mine of gems.

verses.sanskrit: गां विन्दता भगवता गोविन्देनामितौजसा। वराहरूपिणा चान्तर्विक्षोभितजलाविलम्॥१२॥
verses.english: It was in days of yore disturbed by the greatly powerful Lord Govinda (Vishnu) when he assumed the form, of a boar for raising the earth.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षिणा व्रतवता वर्षाणां शतमत्रिणा। अनासादितगाधं च पातालतलमव्ययम्॥१३॥
verses.english: The Rishi Atri of great austerity could not fathom its bottom, lower than the nether regions, though he tried to do it for one hundred years.
verses.bhavadeepa: गां पृथ्वीं विन्दता लम्भमानेन हेतौ शतृप्रत्ययः । तेन हेतुना विक्षोभितेन जलेनाविलं ब्याप्तम् ॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: अध्यात्मयोगनिद्रां च पद्मनाभस्य सेवतः। युगादिकालशयनं विष्णोरमिततेजसः॥१४॥
verses.english: It became the bed of lotus-navelled Vishnu when at the end of every Yuga the immeasurably powerful Deity fell asleep in spiritual meditation.
verses.bhavadeepa: अत्रिणा तलान्वेषिणिति शेषः । गाधं तलम् । पातालस्यापि तलम् अधःस्थम् । अव्ययं पातालादि व्ययेऽप्यविनाशम् ॥१३॥

verses.english: It was the asylum in which (the hill) Mainaka took under the fear of the falling thunderbolt. It was the retreat of the Asuras, overcome (by the celestials) in the fearful battle.
verses.bhavadeepa: सेवतः सेवमानस्य युगादिकालशयनम् । युगं कृतादिकं तस्य आदिभूतो युगादिकालस्तस्मिन् । शयनं तल्पभूतम् ॥१४॥

verses.english: It was the ghee, in the shape of its waters, in the (sacrificial) fire that issued forth from the mouth of Vadava. It was without limits, fathomless, vast, immeasurable and the lord of rivers.
verses.bhavadeepa: डिम्बाहवे डिम्बो भयवतामाक्रन्दस्तद्वति आहवे ’डिम्बोभयध्वनाखण्डे’ इति मेदिनी । तिग्माहव इति पाठः स्पष्टार्थः ॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: महानदीभिर्बह्वीभिः स्पर्धयेव सहस्रशः। अभिसार्यमाणमनिशं ददृशाते महार्णवम्। आपूर्यमाणमत्यर्थं नृत्यमानमिवोर्मिभिः॥१७॥
verses.english: They saw that thousands of great rivers were rushing into it in great pride like rivals of its love. They saw that it was full, always dancing in its waves.
verses.bhavadeepa: वडवा अश्वा तस्या मुखात् उत्पन्नो दीप्तो योऽग्निस्तस्मै तोयहव्यप्रदं गाधः पारश्च नास्ति यस्य सोऽगाधपारस्तम् अत एव विस्तीर्णं विशेषेण स्तीर्णं समन्तत आस्तीर्णम् ॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit:
गम्भीरं तिमिमकरोग्रसंकुलं तं
              गर्जन्तं जलचररावरौद्रनादैः। विस्तीर्णं ददृशतुरम्बरप्रकाशं
              तेऽगाधं निधिमुरुमम्भसामनन्तम्॥१८॥
verses.english: They saw that it was deep and resounded with the terrible uproar of Makaras Timis and other aquatic creatures; they saw it was vast, unlimited as space, unfathomable, infinite and the great reservoir of waters.
